## Terms

### Tumbling Windows

- **Tumbling Windows** · self — Tumbling windows partition time into fixed-duration, contiguous intervals without overlap. Each event timestamp maps to one interval; this describes assignment, not a guarantee that arbitrarily late events will be accepted. MongoDB, Apache Spark, and Confluent independently document this window mode — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-stream-processing/windows.md
